# A steel girder (generated by make_env.py): 3.2 m along +X from the origin, 0.2 x 0.2, on the far side (z -0.55).
new
material new Girder --base-color 0.271 0.294 0.294 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Girder --size 1 --location 1.600 0.550 0.000
scale 3.2 0.2 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Girder
select all
shade flat
export girder.glb
